content.about: Tajikistan is a landlocked country in Central Asia, and more than nine-tenths of it is mountains. The Pamirs, called the "Roof of the World", cover its east. Its people speak Tajik, a form of Persian. The Pamir Highway is one of the highest roads on Earth.

standout.text: The Fedchenko Glacier is one of the longest glaciers outside the polar regions.

didYouKnow: The Nurek Dam is one of the tallest dams in the world.
Ismoil Somoni Peak is its highest point, at 7,495 m.
Tajik embroidery called suzani decorates homes and weddings.
